sar.narrative:
**Suspicious Activity Report — Card C11923-K2 (Customer C11923)**

Between 2016-12-27 and 2016-12-29, card C11923-K2, issued to customer C11923, was used for 83 online card-not-present transactions totaling $3,984.80 in exposure. The activity began on 2016-12-27 with a burst of small online authorizations, including transactions 3578491 ($5.13), 3578496 ($4.96), and 3578997 ($4.88), followed by repeated larger purchases of approximately $92 each (transactions 3578471, 3578475, 3578483, 3578486, 3578506, 3579400, 3579407), a pattern consistent with testing a stolen card number before exploitation. The activity continued through 2016-12-29 with escalating amounts, including transaction 3583368 ($131.30) and transaction 3584401 ($264.18), both flagged with device profile SM-G610F Build/NRD90M#bfff8f74f5, a device not previously associated with this account. Many transactions carried identity-match flags of "New" or "Unknown," and the activity spanned numerous distinct device profiles and email domains inconsistent with the cardholder's established history. The device profile SM-G610F Build/NRD90M#bfff8f74f5 is shared with three other cards (C03938-K1, C05595-K1, C05678-K1), suggesting coordinated use of stolen card numbers across multiple accounts. Customer C11923's historical activity averages $38.46 per transaction across 6,239 prior transactions, making the volume, velocity, and amount pattern of this window highly anomalous. This card has been the subject of five previously confirmed fraud cases (CC-3039, CC-3905, CC-2799, CC-0290, CC-2673), all involving card-not-present fraud or card testing on the same card number. The combination of card testing behavior, new-device usage, shared device linkage, and deviation from established history indicates a high probability (0.94) of fraudulent card-not-present activity, warranting this report.
